items.title: Polynomial-time exact orbit equality and closure classification for torus actions
items.author: Peter Bürgisser; M. Levent Doğan; Visu Makam; Michael Walter; Avi Wigderson
items.source_version: CCC2021 formal30-page CC BY4 publication,2021-07-08; corresponding public native-v1 typesetting carrier
items.difficulty_reason: The non-routine exact classification combines invariant Laurent lattices with support and Newton-cone geometry, then uses linear programming and exact complex-rational power-product arithmetic to control bit complexity. Three orbit problems share this core but require their full closure and one-parameter-subgroup arguments.

primary.label: Formal Theorem1.2: all three exact-orbit algorithms and full input/bit-complexity statement

proof_spans.label: Complete author core generation, Newton-cone/closure structure, exact algorithms, separating/compact consequences and every local continuation

contexts.label: Original torus/action/orbit models, Gaussian-rational and weight-matrix encoding definitions
